Rational factorization of the twin variance difference has sign gamma-mu, and PSD trace bounds plus a constructive mixture prove sharp angular endpoints. The resonant gamma=mu and positivity boundary gamma=3mu are explicitly checked. The delivered checker passed 319 exact-rational finite-generator and kernel comparisons plus a separate seeded 40,000-path lag simulation, as corroboration, not a replacement for the proof.
